insertion position before duplicates or the first index satisfying a monotone predicate
prompts: Find the insertion index before equal elements in an ascending array.
A sorted release list contains repeated version codes. Find where a new code belongs before equal entries.
invariant: All indices below left contain values below target; all indices at or above right contain values at least target.
mantra: Keep [left, right); discard only what is proved too small.
pitfalls: The returned index may equal count and must not be subscripted without checking.
